title: 第156章 任务
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李知眼前出现了只有她自己能看到的对话框：

【作为一个领主，你不仅要有自己的领地，还需要有为你工作且忠心于你的属民，以及为你的领地工作和服务的临时属民，除此之外，安全的防御工事和舒适的基础配套设施和功能性建筑也是提高属民忠诚度的关键。】

【领主主线任务（一）：

1、扩建至少100平方米领地；

2、拥有至少3位附属民，10位临时附属民；

3、增加至少一座防御工事/基础配套设施（能源、排水、绿化等）/功能性建筑（交易区、食堂、医院等）

注：奖励将根据综合评定发放（查看详情）】

【综合评定：新生种族领主榜】

【榜单前1000位领主/临时领主将根据排名获得奖励】

【榜单排名1000~1399861的领主/临时领主将不受惩罚】

【榜单排名在1399861后领主/临时领主将失去领主资格以及领地】

【开始时间：《新生种族保护法》正式生效第12日】

【结束时间：《新生种族保护法》正式生效第30日】

第一次任务对上一次排行榜的前三名非常有利。

据李知所知，区域排行榜前三名，领地是依次递减：300平米、200平米、100平米。

也就是说，即使是第三名，此刻也已经自动完成了主线任务1。

主线任务2的附属民和临时附属民也是一样，排行榜礼包里就会赠送一定的附属民资格。

但这并不意味着，上一次排行榜的前三名就只要做任务3了。

因为奖励是根据综合评定发放，而综合评定在中位数后面的领主，全都会失去领主资格和领地。

这就让本来可以躺平的上次榜单前三名不得不卷了起来。

毕竟，谁又知道别人是不是就因为比你高一个排名，就多了100平米面积、20个附属民资格，就把你拉到了1000位之后。

李知都觉得自己得尽快行动起来。

她手里那一亩地一直留在手上没划取，就是因为想要找一个合适的位置。

现在翡翠山脉的划取资格已经有了，而且极有可能是独家授权。

那她将店铺开在那里，再完善完善基础设施和防御设施，以翡翠山脉的人流量和人才流量，顾客和附属民就都不用着急了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A dialog box that only she could see appeared in front of Li Zhi:

[As a lord, you not only need your own territory, but you also need subjects who work for you and are loyal to you, as well as temporary subjects who work and serve your territory. In addition, safe fortifications, comfortable infrastructure and functional buildings are also the key to improving the loyalty of your subjects.】

[Lord’s main quest (1):

1. Expand the territory by at least 100 square meters;

2. Have at least 3 subjects and 10 temporary subjects;

3. Add at least one defense fortification/basic supporting facilities (energy, drainage, greening, etc.)/functional building (trading area, canteen, hospital, etc.)

Note: Rewards will be issued based on comprehensive evaluation (see details)]

[Comprehensive Evaluation: List of New Race Lords]

[The top 1,000 lords/temporary lords on the list will receive rewards based on their ranking]

[Lords/temporary lords ranked 1000~1399861 on the list will not be punished]

[After ranking 1399861 on the list, the lord/temporary lord will lose the lord qualification and territory]

[Start time: The 12th day when the "New Race Protection Act" officially comes into effect]

[End time: The 30th day when the "New Race Protection Act" officially comes into effect]

The first mission is very beneficial to the top three in the last ranking list.

As far as Li Zhi knows, the top three in the regional rankings have territories in decreasing order: 300 square meters, 200 square meters, and 100 square meters.

In other words, even the third place player has automatically completed the main task 1 at this moment.

The same goes for the subjects and temporary subjects in the main mission 2. A certain subject qualification will be given in the ranking gift pack.

But this does not mean that the top three in the last ranking list only need to do task 3.

Because the rewards are issued based on the comprehensive evaluation, and the lords whose comprehensive evaluation is behind the median will all lose their lord qualifications and territory.

This forced the top three on the last list, which could have been flat, to roll up.

After all, who knows if someone else has pushed you below 1,000 just because they have an extra 100 square meters of area and 20 additional subject qualifications just because they are ranked one higher than you.

Li Zhidu felt that he had to act as soon as possible.

She had kept the acre of land in her hand without declaring it, just because she wanted to find a suitable location.

Now the qualifications for the Emerald Mountain Range are available, and it is very likely to be an exclusive authorization.

Then she would open the shop there and improve the infrastructure and defense facilities. With the flow of people and talents in the Emerald Mountains, customers and subordinates would not have to worry.
